edits.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Input: this exact existing Babel back directional square environment face, native 1254 by 1254.
Primary request: Edit only the sky to remove the artificial perfectly straight vertical cut near its center. Connect the clouds continuously across that cut with natural irregular individual cloud edges and blue gaps. Eliminate narrow radial or triangular cloud streak artifacts near that cut; clouds must have natural nonconcentric patches, without any straight seam. Preserve the exact sun position, golden sunlight, blue sky palette, cloud density and atmosphere.
Strict invariants: Keep ALL architecture, towers, walls, terrain, palms, river, boats, people, horizon and mountains exactly unchanged. Keep the composition and perspective unchanged. Preserve sky colors and major cloud shapes along all four image borders with exceptional fidelity for neighboring panoramic face alignment. This is a localized sky defect repair, no scene redesign, crop, camera change, added people or objects, text or watermark. Fully opaque square output.

qa.assessment: Center vertical cloud boundary removed; continuous irregular clouds and blue gaps replace it. Sun, horizon, architecture, people and foreground retain original visual composition.
qa.limitations: ImageGen can change unaffected pixels; exact border equality is not claimed. Final assembled panorama seams require root QA.
